method: UMAP (n_neighbors=30, min_dist=0.3, seed 42) on standardised Campbell 52-dim syllable features; clusters: HDBSCAN on t-SNE(3d, seed 42, ms=25, mcs=50) -> 50 clusters + 4483 unclustered. 19815 Koe syllables (1496 songs, 753 individuals, 6 sites), of which 0 are human-verified and the rest carry stage-4 classifier family labels (Webb 2021 taxonomy). Battery: ARI vs family 0.222, vs individual 0.014, vs site 0.040, vs sex 0.010 — clusters track family taxonomy, not who/where/sex. Density-scale caveat: at coarser HDBSCAN sensitivity (ms=50, mcs=100) the structure collapses to 2 clusters. Explorer shows 3000 of 19815 syllables (human-verified always included); full table ships as kori_syllables.csv. Plus 241 human-verified syllables (separate Koe batch, manual Raven-style annotation) projected in via UMAP.transform with cluster=-3 sentinel (15-NN majority cluster in nn_cluster).
